tower.notes: Origin = centroid of OSM way 752942780 'Projet de Tour Occitanie' (landuse=construction, ~3210 m2; Wikipedia FR gives a 2200 m2 parcel). No published plan orientation found (Wikipedia FR, libeskind.com). Bearing inferred from the lot geometry: the lot is a ~107 m wedge, ~38 m wide at its north end (station side) and narrowing to ~13 m at its SSE end, squeezed between Bd Pierre-Semard/Canal du Midi (west) and the tracks (east); a 2000 m2 teardrop only fits with its point in the narrow SSE end, i.e. toward Pont Pierre-Paul Riquet / head of the Allees Jean-Jaures. Value = principal axis of the lot polygon, pointing to the narrow end.
